$description: Semantic roles, dim theme. An overlay on dark: a role not named here takes its dark value, so status, series, accent, syntax and highlight colours are shared. Dim only moves the planes and the text, onto the dusk ramp: Omni's original blue-grey values. It may not introduce a role that dark lacks.

page.$description: Body, the content well behind cards

inert.$description: Chart grid, track fills, skeleton states

scrim.$description: The page colour at 80%, behind a modal or drawer.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls. Exempt from AA per WCAG 1.4.3, and never the only signal that a control is off.
